text: dsh-image-vision 是 DeepSeek Harness 插件，通过 llm 服务能力包装和 agent/tool 流程，把粘贴或拖入的图片交给配置的视觉模型转成文字，也会描述飞书/ Lark 工具结果中的图片，并提供 describe_image 本地图片描述工具。适合需要让纯文本主模型理解图片的 Harness 用户。需要在 DSH 中配置可接收图片的视觉模型；飞书图片处理还调用 lark-cli 下载图片。

dsh-image-vision is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns chat images into text for text-only models via a configured vision model. It describes Feishu/Lark tool-result images and provides a tool for local image descriptions. Configure an image-capable model; Feishu/Lark handling uses lark-cli.
想让只能处理文本的 DSH 主模型也能看懂聊天里粘贴或拖入的图片。
读取飞书或 Lark 文档后，希望模型能理解工具结果里的图片内容。
I want my text-only DSH model to describe images attached to a conversation.
dsh-image-vision 的功能「聊天图片转文字描述」：在 agent/pre-step 检查消息图片，并用已配置的视觉模型生成描述文字替换图片块；模型本身支持图片时会保留原图。
dsh-image-vision 的功能「飞书图片描述」：工具结果含飞书/Lark 图片 token 时，调用 lark-cli 下载图片并交给视觉模型描述，再把描述追加到工具结果；每条结果最多处理配置数量。
dsh-image-vision 使用前须知：聊天图片会作为图像附件随请求发送给配置的视觉模型，飞书图片也会下载后交给该模型生成描述。

dsh-image-vision README · dsh-image-vision：Seamless image understanding for **DeepSeek Harness** — lets pure-text main
models read pasted/dropped images and Feishu/Lark images via a configurable
vision model, **without modifying any host code**.

A pure "everything is a plugin" implementation: it wraps a documented `llm`
service method and listens to official agent/tool waterfalls. No `packages/`
files are touched, so it portably runs wherever DeepSeek Harness runs.

> 简体中文说明见 [README.zh.md](./README.zh.md)

---

dsh-image-vision README · What it does：- **Paste / drop an image in chat** — even when the main model is text-only
  (e.g. DeepSeek V4 Flash routed through pi-ai), the image is accepted and
  described to the model as text.
- **Feishu / Lark document images** — `<image token="..."/>` produced by
  `lark_read_doc` and friends is downloaded through `lark-cli` and described;
  the result is injected back as tool output.
- **`describe_image` model tool** — describes a local image file path.
- **Full description, not just OCR** — people, scenes, tables, charts and
  verbatim text are all described, driven by a prompt you can override.

dsh-image-vision README · What it does：Pick a vision model from **ModelScope free community API** (e.g.
`Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct`) or **SiliconFlow** (e.g.
`Qwen/Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct`). Routes are auto-discovered from your `settings`.

---

dsh-image-vision README · Why no host code changes：The web API proxy gates image upload/model-switch by calling
`llm.resolveModelInfo(...).inputModalities` and rejecting when the model does
not declare `image`. Since DSH is "everything is a plugin", this plugin:

dsh-image-vision README · Why no host code changes：1. **Wraps `ctx.llm.resolveModelInfo`** — when the target model lacks `image`
   input and a vision route is configured, the returned capabilities gain
   `image`, so the admission gate lets the image through.
2. **Listens on `agent/pre-step`** — before the real model request, each image
   block is transcribed by the vision model and replaced with its text, so the
   text-only main model only ever receives plain text.

Both steps use documented DSH extension points. No core files are changed.

dsh-image-vision README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6` (**source checkout or installed release** —
  both are supported, see *Installation*).
- Node.js >= 22.19
- A configured **vision model provider** (see *Configuration*).

---

dsh-image-vision README · Installation：Two deployment styles are supported: a **source checkout** (clone the
deepseek-harness repo and run `pnpm dsh web`) and the **installed release**
(`npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`). Both go through the same `dsh plugin` manager;
`@deepseek-ai/*` dependencies are provided by the host and resolved from the
DSH installation anchor.

dsh-image-vision README · From GitHub (recommended)：```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:VeryInt/dsh-image-vision
```

dsh-image-vision README · From a local path (development / validation)：```bash
git clone https://github.com/VeryInt/dsh-image-vision.git /path/to/dsh-image-vision
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-image-vision
```

> Replace `<profile>` with whichever profile you use (`web`, `headless`, ...).
> If pnpm blocks a git dependency's build/prepare script, allowlist the exact
> key it prints under `allowBuilds` in `<profile>/pnpm-workspace.yaml`, then
> re-run.

dsh-image-vision README · From a local path (development / validation)：Restart Harness after installing. The plugin then appears under
**Settings → Plugins**.

dsh-image-vision README · Configuration：Image recognition needs a **vision model provider**. Add an OpenAI-compatible
vision endpoint in the DSH Models page (or `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`), and — this
is the part the Models page does not show — declare `input: [text, image]` on
the model entry.

Example `settings.yaml`:

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    modelscope:
      displayName: ModelScope

Then provide the API key in `~/.credentials.yaml` or as an environment
variable:

```bash
dsh-image-vision README · ModelScope community access: generate at https://modelscope.cn：MODELSCOPE_API_KEY=ms-xxxxxx
section: ModelScope community access: generate at https://modelscope.cn

text:
dsh-image-vision README · SiliconFlow: generate at https://cloud.siliconflow.cn：SILICONFLOW_API_KEY=sk-xxxxxx
```

> **Use a vision model (VL suffix).** Text-only models such as
> `Qwen/Qwen3.5-27B` return empty results even when declared image-capable.

dsh-image-vision README · Plugin vision route：The plugin's `cordis.patch.yml` carries two relevant fields:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-image-vision
      name: dsh-image-vision
      config:

Rules:

- **Both `provider` and `model` set**: used as-is (highest priority).
- **Both empty**: scan every configured provider and pick the first model
  declaring `input: [text, image]` (this is the common case).
- Changing the model = update these two fields **and** make sure the model
  declares `input: [text, image]` in `settings.yaml`.

---

dsh-image-vision README · Verification：After a restart:

1. **Paste an image in chat** — the main model should describe its content
   (rendered as `[图片内容] …`).
2. **Read a Feishu/Lark doc with images** — tool output gains
   `[飞书图片 <token>] …` descriptions.
3. **`describe_image` tool** — ask the model to describe a local image path.

On a transient vision failure the reply still comes back with a
`[图片内容识别失败：…]` / `[飞书图片 … 识别失败：…]` placeholder rather than
failing the whole turn.

---

dsh-image-vision README · Options：| Field | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `provider` | empty | Vision provider route; empty = auto-discover |
| `model` | empty | Vision model id; empty = auto-discover |
| `prompt` | (full description) | Instruction sent to the vision model |
| `maxImagesPerMessage` | 4 | Max images bridged per message; beyond throws |
| `feishuImages` | true | Auto-describe Feishu `<image token>` |
| `maxFeishuImages` | 5 | Max Feishu images per tool result |

dsh-image-vision README · How this differs from oil-oil/dsh-vision：We looked at the community plugin [oil-oil/dsh-vision](https://github.com/oil-oil/dsh-vision)
before writing this one. Key differences:

dsh-image-vision README · How this differs from oil-oil/dsh-vision：| | **oil-oil/dsh-vision** | **dsh-image-vision** |
|---|---|---|
| Mechanism | Replaces the official `deepseek-official` **adapter** with a `VisionBridgeAdapter`; installer disables the built-in `llm-deepseek` | Wraps only `llm.resolveModelInfo` and uses the official `agent/pre-step` waterfall — no adapter replacement, no built-in plugin disabled |
| Works with | Models routed through `deepseek-official` | Any pure-text route (pi-ai `deepseek`, etc.) because it hooks the `llm` service, not a specific route |
| Vision backends | Bundles several (zenmux / Bailian / see config / local OCR) | Reuses your `settings.yaml` / Models vision providers (input: [text, image]) |
| Settings UI | Ships a "Vision Recognition" card | None — config lives in the plugin `cordis.patch.yml` |
| Packaging | TypeScript + tsdown build, many peer deps | Plain JS ESM, minimal peers, no build step |

dsh-image-vision README · How this differs from oil-oil/dsh-vision：In short: oil-oil *replaces the DeepSeek adapter* (so it only affects
`deepseek-official` and requires disabling the built-in plugin); this plugin
*only wraps a llm capability lookup and uses the official pre-step* — it works
for any text-only main model route and makes no destructive changes, which fits
"everything is a plugin" more literally.
